newsitem.headline: TABLE-United Waste Q2 diluted net shr $.32.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTES: (a) Primary and fully diluted earnings per share were $0.38 and $0.37 respectively, for the three month period ended June 30, 1997 before deducting $0.05 per share in charges related to the five poolings-of-interests transactions completed during the second quarter of 1997.
(b) Restated to reflect poolings-of-interests transactions completed during the third quarter of 1996.

(c) Primary and fully diluted earnings per share was $0.27 for the three month period ended June 30, 1997 before deducting $0.09 per share in charges primarily relating to the pooling-of-interests with Salinas Disposal and the sale of the company's Philadelphia transfer station.

(d) Primary and fully diluted earnings per share were $0.63 and $0.61, respectively, for the six month period ended June 30, 1997 before deducting $0.09 and $0.08 per share, respectively, in charges related to the ten poolings-of-interests transactions completed during the first six months of 1997.

(e) Primary and fully diluted earnings per share was $0.41 for the six month period ended June 30, 1997 before deducting $0.08 per share in charges primarily relating to the pooling-of-interests with Salinas Disposal and the sale of the company's Philadelphia transfer station.
Full company name is United Waste Systems Inc.
